subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• The episode "Voices from the Delta" is by documentary producer Giovanni Whitfield.
• It aired in his 2015 radio series titled Listening Across America.
• The episode is structured as a sequence of seven oral interviews.
• According to the series's distributor, National Public Audio (NPA), the series "preserves the testimonies of everyday communities and honors regional traditions across the United States."
• According to Whitfield, he chose to work in the interview format because it helps "carry voices forward without distortion."
prompt: The student wants to provide an example of an episode from Listening Across America. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Included in Whitfield's radio series Listening Across America (2015), "Voices from the Delta" is an episode structured as a sequence of seven oral interviews.
choices.B: Whitfield chose to work in the interview format because it helps "carry voices forward without distortion."
choices.C: The 2015 radio series Listening Across America "preserves the testimonies of everyday communities and honors regional traditions across the United States."
choices.D: The episode by Whitfield is structured as a sequence of seven oral interviews.

explanation: Choice A is the best answer. The sentence provides an example of an episode from Listening Across America by naming a specific episode ("Voices from the Delta") and clearly stating that it is included in Whitfield's radio series Listening Across America (2015).
